Professional experience

My work has developed across travel consulting, tour coordination, reservations, documentation support and customer service.

Senior Tours & Travel Consultant — Trawell Safaris Limited

July 2025 – Present

In my current role with Trawell Safaris Limited, I support the planning and coordination of safari, leisure, corporate and multi-destination travel. My responsibilities include preparing customized itineraries and quotations, coordinating flight and hotel arrangements, and bringing together transfers, excursions and ground transportation as required. I help clients understand travel-documentation requirements and provide guidance on visa application preparation, travel insurance information and destination formalities.

I also work with Amadeus for flight reservations, fare calculations, ticket issuance and booking changes. A key part of the role is communicating with suppliers and responding to changes that can affect a client’s journey. I aim to keep arrangements organized, provide clear updates and help identify practical solutions when a booking or itinerary needs attention.

Senior Tours & Travel Consultant — Lemur House of Travel Ltd

January 2021 – July 2025

At Lemur House of Travel, I supported individual travellers, groups and B2B and B2C clients with travel arrangements across destinations in Africa, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. My work included preparing holiday packages, safari itineraries, quotations, group bookings and accommodation arrangements. I also supported clients with visa documentation and travel formalities, helping them organize application materials and understand the relevant process.

My responsibilities involved working with hotels and travel suppliers to source options and negotiate rates, coordinating multiple components of trips and supporting client relationships through responsive communication. My CV records support for more than 300 visa applications and approximately 20% in client cost savings through supplier-rate negotiation. These figures summarize the experience stated in my CV and can be updated if more precise records are available.

Education and professional learning

I hold a Diploma in Travel & Tourism with an IATA Foundation – Amadeus Option from Kenya Utalii College, completed in 2023. My education also includes a Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism & Travel Management from Nairobi Institute of Business Studies. My CV lists an IATA Foundation Certificate, a Travel Consultant Certificate and an Amadeus GDS Certification.

This educational background supports my practical work in reservations, travel formalities, customer service and tourism operations. I continue to build on that foundation through hands-on experience with travel systems, suppliers and a range of client requirements.

Languages and working approach

I speak English fluently and Swahili as my native language. In my work, I value accuracy, respectful communication, client confidentiality and reliable follow-through. I understand that travel documentation and booking details can contain personal information, so confidential client records should be handled appropriately and should never be included in a public portfolio.

I am interested in opportunities that make use of my experience in travel consulting, reservations, ticketing, visa documentation support, itinerary planning, safari coordination, customer support and travel operations. I am open to professional networking and conversations with travel businesses, tour operators, travel technology teams and employers seeking a detail-oriented travel professional.
